title: GPT-4o
before: Voice assistants chained speech recognition, a text model and speech synthesis.
problem: That chain adds seconds of latency and discards tone, emotion and overlapping speech.
breakthrough: One model trained across text, audio and vision, responding to audio in about 320 milliseconds on average.
why: It made real-time spoken conversation with a model possible, and set the native-multimodal expectation.
next: Realtime APIs, and native multimodality across the frontier.
inherits: One model for all modalities rather than a pipeline.
